name: Tom Wallace
bio: Scored 11 touchdowns (66 points) against Lake Placid on Oct 16, 1926, and 24 TDs that season. Nicknamed the 'Galloping Ghost'. Later captain at Georgetown, then a lawyer and Franklin County probation officer; died 1969.
